webots.notes: Sensor spokes are the measured sector minima. Reward unavailable in Webots inference. Q-only older telemetry has no mask or wheel readings; velocity is estimated from GPS/IMU differences. The final frame uses the recorded terminal position and has no fabricated IMU/LiDAR sample.

synchronization: global_row is the stable key for per-video frame index CSV files
raw_pose_timing: robot and lidar are pre-action; post pose, reward and events are after action
note: The interrupted partial episode is kept separately. It was restarted from its original episode-boundary checkpoint.

frame_sampling.retained: first, last, collision and goal in full/evaluation; first and last in overview

ray_storage: 16 sampled rays from the 128 measured beams per step; five policy sector minima retained.
